name: Emberhog
description: A stocky Lexling whose quills smoulder when it's cross, which is most of the time. Usually keeps to the dry ridges.

battle.clue: Milo glances at the stream behind you, then back at the Emberhog's flames.

name: Drizzlet
description: A droplet-shaped Lexling that lives in fast, cold streams. It will splash anyone, any time, for any reason.

name: Pebblit
description: A small, pebble-shelled Lexling that burrows under rocks. Mutters to itself while it digs.

name: Puffkin
description: A seed-puff of a Lexling that rides every breeze it can find. Lighter than it looks, and it looks very light.
